sources.title: piper-voices: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview piper-voices is a collection of pre-trained voice models for the Piper text-to-speech system, maintained by rhasspy. Piper is a lightweight, offline-capable TTS engine designed for edge deployment and resource-constrained environments. The voice collection provides multiple speaker models across different languages and genders that work with Piper's vocoder-based architecture. The ...
